items.quote: Ashavi Korington set the direction for coaching and mentoring junior officers across the public service.
She led upholding governance and audit standards across the department.
Ashavi drove service-level targets for frontline operations for the whole division.
Ashavi delivered her share of media interviews and press conferences reliably.
Ashavi Korington spearheaded the shift to a new way of working after two branches were combined at the national level.
She championed cost savings across procurement and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Ashavi Korington set the direction for evidence-based evaluation of programme outcomes across the public service.
Ashavi was recognised sector-wide for her leadership of the settlement of a long-running contract dispute.
She headed long-term strategy for the sector, setting priorities for several teams.
She took ownership of the digital redesign of the permit system and steered it to completion.
